title: Sociaal-Culturele Ontwikkelingen in Nederland, SOCON panel 1990-2007
descriptions: Respondents of the cross-sectional, nationally representative 1990 SOCON survey were reapproached in 2007. Data contain variables on demographics, education and occupation, upbringing, attitudes (e.g. towards EU), voting, and recall questions. Primary goal of the panel was to test to what extent respondents are able to recall previous attitudes. Secondary, to create a longitudinal dataset that would allow to study changes in attitudes and selected behaviours over time.
